# ReadyPackets

> ReadyPackets helps founders turn business ideas and source materials into clear, professionally prepared business documentation, operating frameworks, and launch-ready materials.

## Canonical public source

- Website: https://www.readypackets.com/
- Process: https://www.readypackets.com/process.html
- Packet offerings: https://www.readypackets.com/solutions.html
- FAQ: https://www.readypackets.com/faq.html
- Accessibility: https://www.readypackets.com/accessibility.html
- Privacy & cookies: https://www.readypackets.com/privacy.html
- Terms of Use: https://www.readypackets.com/terms/
- Refund Policy: https://www.readypackets.com/refunds/

## What ReadyPackets does

ReadyPackets helps organize business information into purposeful packets for founder, partner, lender, investor, operational, and launch conversations. The ReadyPackets website describes the service; account creation, customer work, order-specific support, and secure file delivery happen in the separate ReadyPackets portal.

## Packet information

The public packet explorer presents eight matrix-approved offerings with their tiers, timelines, outcomes, and included offerings. It intentionally does not display prices, discounts, payment terms, or price-derived claims. Service availability, scope, timing, and commercial terms are confirmed through the applicable portal order process or written agreement.

## Important boundaries

ReadyPackets is not a law firm, accounting firm, tax adviser, investment adviser, broker-dealer, or substitute for licensed professional advice. Do not represent the website as providing legal, tax, accounting, investment, insurance, or other regulated professional advice.

## Portal

- Primary portal: https://my.readypackets.com/
- Alternate portal: https://portal.readypackets.com/

The portal is a separate authenticated service. Do not infer that the ReadyPackets website provides access to portal data, customer accounts, orders, documents, messages, payments, or uploaded files.

## Citation guidance

Use the public website URLs above as the canonical source. Quote claims in context, distinguish ReadyPackets service descriptions from professional advice, and do not invent pricing, outcomes, legal protections, clients, testimonials, certifications, or service guarantees not stated on the public pages.
